info.name: MarketLink API Collection
info.description: Complete, production-accurate Postman Collection for testing and demonstrating MarketLink MERN Backend APIs. Includes automated token saving, role handling (Customer, Farmer, Admin), pre-configured variables, and realistic request payloads matching Mongoose models and controllers.

item.name: 01. System & Health
item.description: Health check and platform status endpoints.

request.description: Check if the server is running and accessible. Public route.

item.name: 02. Authentication
item.description: User registration, authentication, token retrieval, session inspection, and logout.

request.description: Register a new customer account. Returns token and safe user profile. Automatically saves token to customerToken and authToken.
Register a new farmer account. Requires approval from Admin before the farmer can log in. Saves pendingFarmerUserId for testing Admin Approval.
Login with seeded Admin credentials (admin@marketlink.com / admin123). Automatically stores JWT to adminToken and authToken variables.
Login with seeded Farmer credentials (bilal@marketlink.com / farmer123). Stores JWT to farmerToken and authToken variables.
Login with seeded Customer credentials (ali@marketlink.com / customer123). Stores JWT to customerToken and authToken variables.
Returns the currently authenticated user's profile based on the Bearer JWT token.
Logs out the authenticated user.
Updates the authenticated user's name, phone, or address.

item.name: 04. Markets
item.description: Farmers market discovery, geo-location queries, and admin market administration.

query.description: Filter by city substring in address

request.description: Fetch list of all active markets with optional day and city filters. Automatically saves the first market ID to marketId.
Returns markets located within radiusKm using MongoDB 2dsphere $near query.
Retrieve complete details for a single market.
Create a new market listing. Requires Admin role.
Update an existing market's schedule, name, or location. Requires Admin role.
Remove a market listing. Requires Admin role.

item.name: 05. Categories (Admin)
item.description: Manage product categories. In this backend, Category routes are mounted at /api/admin/categories and require Admin authorization.

request.description: Returns all active product categories. Requires Admin role.
Creates a new category. Name must be unique. Requires Admin role.
Updates category details. Requires Admin role.
Deletes a category. Requires Admin role.

item.name: 06. Farmers
item.description: Discover farmer stall profiles, view their product catalogs, and update farmer profile settings.

request.description: List all farmer profiles with their user details populated. Automatically sets farmerId variable to the first farmer.
Get detailed farmer profile including stall information, pickup windows, and associated markets.
Retrieves all currently available products for a specific farmer stall.
Update stall name, operating days, pickup windows, and stall coordinates. Requires Farmer role.

item.name: 07. Products
item.description: Product catalog browsing, search/filter, and farmer inventory management.

request.description: Search and filter products with pagination. Automatically sets productId to the first returned product.
Fetch single product details with farmer stall name populated.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Fresh Red Strawberries",
  "category": "Fruits",
  "description": "Farm-fresh ripe and sweet handpicked strawberries",
  "price": 350,
  "unit": "kg",
  "stockQuantity": 45,
  "imageUrl": "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1464965911861-746a04b4bca6",
  "isAvailable": true
}

request.description: Adds a new product to the logged-in farmer's inventory. Unit enum: kg, dozen, piece, litre, bunch. Requires Farmer role.
Update product price, quantity, or description. Farmer can only update their own products. Requires Farmer role.
Quick toggle to mark product as in-stock or out-of-stock. Requires Farmer role.
Creates an item marked with isTemplate: true for easy weekly re-listing. Requires Farmer role.
Permanently deletes a product owned by the farmer. Requires Farmer role.

item.name: 08. Orders
item.description: Order placement, order lifecycle (accepted, ready, completed), customer modifications, and cancellations.

exec: // Compute next Saturday at 10:00 AM (Farmer operates on Saturday with 12h cutoff rule)
var dayOfWeek = now.getDay(); // 0 is Sun, 6 is Sat

request.description: Places a pre-order for market pickup. Pre-request script automatically calculates the next Saturday pickup date to satisfy the farmer's schedule and 12h advance cutoff rule. Saves orderId automatically.
Returns the authenticated customer's order history with farmer and market info populated. Requires Customer role.

item.name: 3. Get Order by ID (Owner or Admin)

request.description: Fetch single order details. Only accessible by the customer who ordered, the receiving farmer, or an admin.
Returns all customer orders received by the logged-in farmer. Requires Farmer role.
Aggregates farmer revenue, total orders, pending orders, and top selling products. Requires Farmer role.
Farmer accepts order. Sends in-app notification and email to customer. Status options: accepted, ready, completed, declined. Requires Farmer role.

item.name: 7. Update Order Status - Ready for Pickup (Farmer Only)

request.description: Farmer marks order ready for customer pickup. Requires Farmer role.
Farmer marks order completed upon handover. Allows customer to subsequently review this order. Requires Farmer role.
Modify quantities or items before the cutoff window. Only allowed while status is 'placed' or 'accepted'. Requires Customer role.
Cancel order before the cutoff window. Restocks product quantities and notifies farmer. Requires Customer role.

item.name: 09. Reviews
item.description: Order-based verified reviews, farmer responses, and admin content moderation.

request.description: Submit a rating (1-5) and review for a completed order. Order status MUST be 'completed'. Recalculates farmer rating automatically. Requires Customer role.
Returns all customer reviews and ratings for a farmer stall. Public route.
Returns all reviews associated with a specific product. Public route.
Farmer adds a public response to a customer's review on their stall. Requires Farmer role.
Admin moderation endpoint to remove inappropriate or spam reviews. Recalculates farmer rating. Requires Admin role.

item.name: 10. Favorites
item.description: Customer saved farmer stalls for quick re-ordering.

request.description: Returns list of favorited farmer stalls with farmer profile and user details populated.
Toggles bookmarking a farmer stall. Returns { favorited: true } or { favorited: false }.

item.name: 11. Notifications
item.description: User notification inbox, read receipts, and bulk updates.

request.description: Fetches up to 50 latest in-app notifications for the authenticated user. Automatically sets notificationId.
Marks a specific notification as read.
Marks all pending unread notifications as read for the logged-in user.

item.name: 12. Admin Management
item.description: Platform administration, analytics dashboards, revenue reports, farmer approval workflows, and moderation.

request.description: Returns platform-wide metrics: totalFarmers, totalCustomers, totalMarkets, totalOrders. Requires Admin role.
Aggregates total completed orders, gross platform revenue, and top 5 revenue-generating farmers. Requires Admin role.
Fetches list of registered farmers awaiting admin approval. Automatically sets pendingFarmerUserId. Requires Admin role.
Approves a pending farmer user account (sets isApproved: true). The farmer can now log in. Requires Admin role.
Suspends a farmer account (sets isActive: false). Requires Admin role.
Admin can activate or deactivate customer accounts. Requires Admin role.
Admin forced removal of a prohibited or inappropriate product listing. Requires Admin role.

item.name: 13. AI Assistant
item.description: Google Gemini 1.5 Flash powered assistant for answering questions about local produce, markets, and pickup policies. Operates offline with graceful fallback if GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured.

request.description: Send query to MarketLink AI. Public endpoint. Returns friendly guidance.

item.name: 14. Media Upload
item.description: Direct memory-buffer image upload to Cloudinary for product and stall images.

formdata.description: Image file to upload (JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 5MB)

request.description: Uploads an image to Cloudinary folder 'marketlink' via multer memoryStorage. Requires JWT authentication and valid CLOUDINARY credentials in .env.
